name: DisableScavMode
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
Do you feel that Scaving in single player makes the game too easy, but are always tempted when you see the Scav selection in the Select your Character screen?

Well, be tempted no more!

This simple mod disables Scav character selection, so you can only pick your PMC character.

I take no credit for this mod, this is just a bastardization of the Stay in Tarkov project, with all code removed except the DisableScav code.

All credits go to Paulov-t and MaoMao / TheMaoci. I just isolated this small feature for single player.
